clauses.quote: A Teacher’s official personnel file shall be treated as confidential.
Documentation of a Teacher’s performance shall be maintained in her/his official personnel file.
Anonymous material shall not be placed in a Teacher’s official personnel file.
A Teacher shall be permitted to examine her/his own official personnel file in the presence of a DCPS Office of Human Resources representative.
A Teacher shall be permitted to obtain a copy of the material contained in her/his official personnel files pursuant to D.C. Code § 1-631.05.

A WTU representative shall be permitted to examine a Teacher’s official personnel file in the presence of a representative from the DCPS Office of Human Resources upon written authorization from the Teacher.
The DCPS Office of Human Resources shall maintain a record reflecting the name and title of each person who has been granted access to a Teacher’s official personnel file.
clauses.subject_text: The DCPS Office of Human Resources

clauses.quote: Teachers shall be provided a copy of the record upon request.
DCPS shall keep accurate records pertaining to building and system seniority for each Teacher.

Documentation that may lead to or result in an adverse action against a Teacher shall not be placed in a Teacher’s official personnel file until a copy of such material has been provided to the Teacher.
clauses.subject_text: Documentation that may lead to or result in an adverse action against a Teacher

clauses.quote: Placement of material in a Teacher’s official personnel file shall not be construed as agreement by the Teacher with the contents of the material.
